programme.title: Daughter of the Wolf
programme.desc: Den tidligere kommandosoldat Clair Hamilton (Gina Carano) vender hjem efter en udstationering, da hendes far er gået bort, og nu har hun vanskeligt ved at håndtere sin 13-årige søn, Charlie (Anton Gillis-Adelman).

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.desc: Gene Autry stops singing long enough to take on some nasty land developers in this oldtime western from Republic Pictures. Genes longtime sidekick Smiley Burnette gets to sing a few, too, including She Works Third Tub at the Laundry.

programme.title: Down Texas Way
programme.desc: The sixth film in Monogram's Rough Rider series once again follows Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), Tom McCoy (Tim McCall), and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) as undercover US Marshals posing as outlaws in order to confound their enemies. When Sandy is framed for murder by a gang of frontier racketeers who hope to take over a small town as their headquarters, Buck and Tom must work separately to save their buddy from a lynch mob and foil the crook's dastardly schemes.

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Wayne was still a few years from major stardom when he appeared as John Mason, a man seeking revenge for his fathers murder. Marion Burns stars as Alice, Masons love interest, while Reed Howes stars as Masons friend and rival for Alices affection. When Mason finally tracks down the man responsible for his fathers death, will Ben help, or stand in his way? Produced by Lone Star Pictures, the group behind many of Waynes early films, The Dawn Rider is a stirring yarn about the price of vengeance.

programme.title: Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western about a man avenging the murder of his parents. Other cast members include frequent Wayne sidekick George 'Gabby Hayes', plus Yakima Canutt, Sheila Terry, and Jack Rockwell. This Paul Malvern Production from director Robert N. Bradbury also features Earl Dwire, one of the great B-movie villains, as Zanti, the ruthless bandit who sets the action in motion.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Aunt Clara's Old Flame
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: Illegal Separation
programme.desc: After an argument, Gladys Kravitz locks her husband out of their home. The Stephens invite Abner to spend the night at their place. Later, when it appears that Abner, using all his privileges as a guest, is more than satisfied with the arrangements and is making no effort to return to his own home, Darrin demands that Samantha take action. Not only is Samantha unsuccessful in all her attempts to effect a reconciliation, but she learns that Gladys wants a divorce. When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Feeling that one of the happiest days of her life is the day a man proposes marriage, and a woman accepts him, Samantha projects Gladys and Abner in their dreams back to that day. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

programme.title: A Change Of Face
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Remember The Main
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch.

programme.title: Eat At Mario's
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Cousin Edgar
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Alias Darrin Stephens
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: A Very Special Delivery
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: My Grandson, The Warlock
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: The Joker Is A Card
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Trick Or Treat
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: The Very Informal Dress
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: And Then I Wrote
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Junior Executive
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Remember The Main
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch.

programme.title: Eat At Mario's
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Cousin Edgar
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Alias Darrin Stephens
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: A Very Special Delivery
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Doch das Team wächst stetig, um dem riesigen Berg an Aufträgen gerecht zu werden.

programme.title: Unsere tollen Tanten in der Südsee
programme.desc: Die fünf Jungs der Band «Sunny Boys» verschlägt es nach Polynesien, wo sie durch äußere Umstände gezwungen werden, sich wieder in Frauenklamotten zu werfen: Ein Kopfjäger-Stamm macht nur Jagd auf Männer. Diesmal kommt auch Udo Jürgens nicht umhin, sich als Dame zu verkleiden, der sich bis dato immer geziert hat. \n\nDer dritte Teil der «Tolle Tanten»-Trilogie ist der beste: Nach «Unsere tollen Tanten» (1961) und «Unsere tollen Nichten» (1962) ging es 1963 tatsächlich ab in die Südsee. Und da hatten alle viel Spaß, was sich auch im Film zeigt. Der wurde im Ultrascope-Format gedreht, einer CinemaScope-Abart: ungewöhnlich aufwendig für so einen «kleinen» Film. Wer gepflegte Albernheiten mag und die Banalität der frühen 60er-Jahre-Schlager zu schätzen weiß, liegt hier goldrichtig.

programme.desc: In den 70er Jahren starteten Ernst Arendt und Hans Schweiger ein ehrgeiziges Projekt: Sie wollten die bekanntesten heimischen Vögel in bester Bild- und Tonqualität präsentieren. Trotz der damaligen technischen Herausforderungen gelang es ihnen nach zwei Jahren harter Arbeit, die richtigen Geräte zu finden und improvisieren, um den Gesang ihrer gefiederten Stars authentisch einzufangen.

programme.title: Faszination Vogesen - Im Tal der Störche
programme.desc: Die Vogesen faszinieren mit ihrer natürlichen Schönheit und ihrer reichen Tierwelt, darunter die majestätischen Störche. Diese Region im Osten Frankreichs lockt Besucher mit malerischen Tälern, bewaldeten Hügeln und historischen Dörfern. Wanderer können die Vielfalt der Landschaft entdecken, während Kulturliebhaber historische Burgen und charmante Fachwerkhäuser erkunden können. Die Vogesen sind ein Paradies für Naturliebhaber und bieten unvergessliche Erlebnisse für Jung und Alt.

programme.title: Tiere vor der Kamera - Die Geier der spanischen Sierra
programme.desc: Arendt und Schweiger zeigen in "Tiere vor der Kamera" das wahre Verhalten von Gänsegeiern. Ihre Expedition führt sie von den Alpen bis nach Südspanien, wo sie das Privatleben der Geier in felsigen Klüften festhalten. Geier sind liebevolle Eltern, die sogar Schatten spenden. Interessant ist ihr Verhalten bei der Nahrungsaufnahme, ohne feste Rangordnung. Ihr majestätischer Flug über die weite Landschaft Südspaniens ist von berückender Schönheit.

programme.desc: Frank har fået tilsendt en bygsort, der hedder Erhard Frederiksen, som efter planen skal bruges til ølbrygning. Hestene skal over åen for at græsse, hvad mon føllet siger til det? I år forsøger Frank sig med at dyrke sennep, og i dag skal sennepsstykket eftersås med den lille såmaskine. Den gamle radrenser trænger både til nye håndtag og skær, heldigt at Frank har flere stående, så han ud af to radrensere kan få en som virker. Og endelig skal gæslingerne flyttes fra den indendørs varmelampe til den ægte sol i den fri natur. Sendt første gang 04.05.11 (Senderinfo).

Og det går ikke stille for sig, når de konfronteres af politiet, spiller skak med små børn og inviteres til klassisk armensk brunch, som indebærer koklovesuppe og vodka tidligt om morgenen. (Senderinfo).

Og så skal der virkelig tænkes ud af boksen når der i ugens store opgave skal bygges havemøbler ud af kabeltromler. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hammerslag 2023 – Hurtigt handlet på Bornholm
programme.desc: Når drømmeboligen er der, må man slå hurtigt til. Lars Lyng og Kristine Virén dyster mod Christian Torp og Mira Lie Nielsen, når de først imponeres af et minimalistisk træhus i Allinge med klipper i baghaven. Derefter går turen til Svaneke, hvor eksperterne skal gætte prisen på et yndigt, lille byhus med udsigt over Svanekes røde tegltage. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Danmark i Den kolde Krig
programme.desc: Dansk dokumentarserie fra 2000. Kort tid efter 2. verdenskrig bider frygten sig fast i det danske samfund. En regulær frygt for at russerne vil besætte landet. På ganske kort tid går Danmark fra at være neutralt til at melde sig under fanerne i den vestlige blok. Frygten fører også til, at en gruppe gamle modstandsfolk danner et hemmelig netværk – der skal i aktion, hvis russerne besætter landet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Danmark i Den kolde Krig
programme.desc: Dansk dokumentarserie fra 2000. En lille gruppe mænd tager den kolde krig så alvorligt, at de også i det skjulte arbejder på at bekæmpe kommunisterne. Det sker ved hjælp af ulovlige aflytninger, registreringer og en nøje overvågning af Danmarks Kommunistiske Parti – dets medlemmer og aktiviteter. Det sker i en tid hvor socialdemokrater kæmper mod kommunister, og hvor begivenhederne ude i verden får stor betydning i Danmark. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Justitsmord
programme.desc: Dansk dokumentarserie fra 1998. En gammel modstandsmand kalder Corfitz Ulfeldt for den største landsforræder, vi nogensinde har haft. Rigshofmesterens kone Leonora Christine indespærres i Blåtårn, men hvad sker der med ham? Piet van Deurs forsøger sammen med statsadvokat Erik Merlung, forsvarsadvokat Jørgen Jacobsen og en række vidner at nå frem til en konklusion – var det justitsmord? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vores vidunderlige vulkaner
programme.desc: Hvorfor eksisterer vulkaner, og hvad skyldes deres voldsomme udbrud? De lunefulde kæmper kan eksplodere uden varsel og forårsage enorme ødelæggelser. Tag med til Napoli og oplev, hvad der sker, når vulkaner går fra at være underværker til menneskelige katastrofer. Bestig Vesuvs enorme krater og hør, hvad vi – og videnskaben – kan gøre for at beskytte os mod deres altødelæggende vrede. (Senderinfo).

Her findes næsten en tredjedel af Jordens havpattedyrarter, og havet er også berømt for hajer såsom tyrehajer og de truede hammerhajer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nørgaards særlige sans
programme.desc: Fænomenet teenagere er helt nyt, da 25-årige Jørgen Nørgaard i 1958 overtager familiens skrantende sørgemagasin på Strøget i København. Gennem 5 årtier udvikler han sin egen måde at sælge tøj på. Han hylder ungdommen og blander købmandsgerning med kunst og design, bl.a. designikonet, den stribede 101-t-shirt fra 1967. I denne dokumentar, fyldt med historisk arkivmateriale og mennesker, som har været tæt på Jørgen Nørgaard, udforsker vi Nørgaards helt særlige sans for tendenser og kvalitet. (Senderinfo).

I håbet om at friheden er lige om hjørnet, holder de ud og konfronteres med overvældende fattigdom, hjemløshed og afhængighed – forhold, der påvirker 150 million børn og unge verden over. programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: El ansia
programme.desc: Miriam Blaylock (Catherine Deneuve), una hermosa y centenaria vampiresa, ve como su amante John (David Bowie) pierde el don de la juventud eterna. Por eso contactan con la doctora Sarah (Susan Sarandon), una mujer que está investigando el envejecimiento prematuro y de la que Miriam queda totalmente enamorada.

programme.title: El exorcismo de Emily Rose
programme.desc: Emily Rose muere tras un exorcismo realizado por el padre Moore, quien es acusado de homicidio. La abogada Erin Bruner lo defiende a cambio de un contrato, pero, según avanza en su relación con el sacerdote, sus creencias ateas se ven desafiadas por extraños sucesos.

programme.title: Las pesadillas de Freddy
programme.sub-title: El hotel de los corazones rotos
programme.desc: Un reportero especializado en historias sensacionalistas es enviado al Hotel Springwood para investigar un supuesto avistamiento de Elvis. Allí descubre que todo lo que escribe se convierte en realidad. Al mismo tiempo, un hombre que sobrevive a un accidente de tráfico lucha por recuperar la memoria con la ayuda de su familia.

programme.title: The Monkey
programme.desc: Cuando los gemelos Hal y Bill descubren el antiguo mono de juguete de su padre en el ático, una serie de truculentas muertes comienzan a ocurrir a su alrededor. Los hermanos deciden tirar el mono y continuar con sus vidas, distanciándose con el paso de los años. Pero cuando las misteriosas muertes vuelven a sucederse, Hal y Bill deberán reunirse para destruir el mono antes de que acabe con las vidas de todos a su alrededor.

programme.title: Benny Loves You
programme.desc: Los juguetes van y vienen, pero un osito de peluche es para toda la vida. Si no que se lo pregunten a Jack, un diseñador de juguetes de 35 años y un perdedor que aún vive con sus padres. Cuando estos fallecen intenta comenzar una nueva vida y se deshace del osito que le ha acompañado desde la infancia. Mala idea porque el el peluche diabólico está locamente celoso de su dueño.

programme.title: Gnomos
programme.desc: En la tranquila localidad de Nompton, los preparativos para el festival Gnome-a-Palooza prometen revitalizar un pueblo al borde de la ruina. Pero cuando el veterano policía Arnold Kipps custodia una antigua estatua recién llegada al pueblo, despierta sin saberlo una maldición que permanecía sellada desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Mientras su excompañera Ellie McKay regresa para supervisar recortes en la comisaría, una presencia oscura cobra vida y los primeros gritos resuenan en la oscuridad.

programme.title: Los payasos asesinos del espacio exterior
programme.desc: Deb y Mike ven caer un meteorito en el bosque. Cuando se acercan a investigar descubren que se trata de una carpa de circo llena de payasos asesinos. Después de huir de ellos por los pelos, acuden a la comisaría donde chocan con la incredulidad de Kirk, un viejo policía antipático. Sin embargo, ante su insistencia, consiguen la ayuda de Dave, un amigo de la infancia de Deb, que les ayuda en este surrealista caso. Mientras, la población sufre los hilarantes ataques de los payasos.

programme.title: Terrifier 2: El payaso siniestro
programme.desc: Un año después de la masacre del condado de Miles, el asesino en serie Art the Clown regresa para causar estragos en una familia en pleno duelo. En esta ocasión los que se enfrentan a Art son un joven llamado Jonathan que tiene una obsesión particular con él y su hermana mayor Sienna, una artista con una afición por el cosplay.Heredera de la creatividad de su difunto padre, de su propensión al desequilibrio mental y de su vínculo extraño y sobrenatural con Art, Sienna está transformando minuciosamente el diseño de un personaje de espada y brujería que su padre dibujó para ella en un disfraz para Halloween. Las líneas entre la pesadilla y la realidad se entrecruzan cuando una aparición demoníaca guía a Art hasta los hermanos y el número de cadáveres va en aumento. Para sobrevivir, Sienna tendrá que convertirse en una heroína y enfrentarse a su antagonista en un mundo de sueños, fantasía y leyenda.

programme.title: Terrifier 3: Payaso Siniestro
programme.desc: En Nochebuena, el payaso Art vuelve a aterrorizar al condado de Miles, amenazando la tranquilidad de Sienna y su hermano, supervivientes de su anterior masacre. Mientras intentan superar su traumático pasado y disfrutar de la Navidad, Art transforma la festividad en una nueva pesadilla, demostrando que ninguna festividad está a salvo de su terror.

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc:
Franka versucht, Mo und Julius davon zu überzeugen, sich noch eine Chance als Paar zu geben. Doch beide geben vor, nichts als Freundschaft voneinander zu wollen. Erst ein Traum lässt Mo erkennen, dass er noch immer Gefühle für Julius hat. Als er ihm das gestehen will, glaubt er, Julius habe sich wieder Richard zugewandt ...

Lou erträgt die Vorstellung nicht, dass Richard nach Kuala Lumpur geht und nicht mehr Teil ihres Lebens ist. Sie bittet Richard, mit nach München zu ziehen. Doch kaum hat er zugesagt, taucht Victoria auf und macht ihm ein Angebot, das seine Pläne völlig über den Haufen wirft.

Michael erfährt von Britta, dass er möglicherweise eine tödliche Erbkrankheit hat. Überstürzt bucht er einen Flug nach New York zu einer Spezialistin, ohne seiner Familie über die Diagnose zu informieren. Mit einer romantischen Geste nimmt er Abschied von der ahnungslosen Carla.

Toni sucht nach einer sinnvollen Aufgabe und bietet Britta an, die Pflegestrukturen im Krankenhaus zu reformieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc:
Larissa hilft Adam, der nicht ahnt, dass sie einen perfiden Plan verfolgt. Massimo muss erkennen, dass Adam ihm zuvorgekommen ist. Emilia ist enttäuscht, als Erik ihr den DJ-Gig wieder absagt.

Larissa bekommt mit, dass Werner Adam "Fürstenhof"-Anteile in Aussicht gestellt hat. Als sie erfährt, dass die Küche dringend einen neuen Küchenchef braucht, lässt sie zu Adams Gunsten ihre Kontakte spielen und vermittelt ihm den berühmten Sternekoch Fernando Oliveira. Obwohl sie sich Adam gegenüber selbstlos und großzügig gibt, verrät sie ihrem alten Freund Fernando ihren wahren Plan: Adam soll sich in sie verlieben, damit sie ihm später seine Anteile abnehmen kann.

Alexander eröffnet Massimo und Adam Werners Plan. Wenn die beiden sich in den kommenden Wochen als würdige Nachfolger erweisen, wird er ihnen seine Anteile überschreiben. Alexander soll darauf ein Auge haben. Massimo und Adam nehmen die Herausforderung an. Obwohl Massimo die Unterstützung seines Vaters Alexander hat, kommt Adam ihm mit einer Lösung für den neuen Küchenchef zuvor.

Emilia macht Olivia klar, dass Erik sie nie offiziell für die Club-Eröffnung engagiert hat. Da Erik jedoch kein "Nein" von Emilia akzeptieren möchte, stimmt Olivia ihrem einmaligen Auftritt als DJ zu. Emilia stürzt sich in die Vorbereitung und ist voller Vorfreude. Als Erik jedoch überraschend das Angebot eines bekannten DJs bekommt, sagt er der enttäuschten Emilia wieder ab. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Seelöwe & Co. – tierisch beliebt
programme.sub-title: Gorillas an der Bar und vorsichtige Giraffen
programme.desc:
Das Becken der Brillenpinguine bekommt eine Schönheitskur, Giraffen testen ein neues Geschicklichkeits-Spielzeug, Jägerlieste (Lachender Hans) üben für ihren großen Auftritt, bei den Gorillas öffnet wieder die „Teebar“, Rabengeier Nestor ist beim Training kitzlig und Tierpfleger Bene nimmt Abschied: Im Erlebnis-Zoo Hannover pulsiert das Leben wie immer tierisch!

**Zungenakrobatik**

Im Sambesi-Revier testen die Giraffen Jamila und Niobe eine neue Beschäftigung. Die hölzernen Futterbretter verlangen Geschicklichkeit, denn die Pellets müssen mit der bis zu 50 Zentimeter langen Zunge durch kleine Öffnungen herausgefischt werden.

Giraffen sind sehr vorsichtige Fluchttiere – alles Neue wird erst einmal misstrauisch beäugt. Mit viel Geduld lockt Tierpfleger Fabian seine Schützlinge näher heran. Wird Jamila den entscheidenden Versuch wagen? Oder bleibt sie lieber auf Sicherheitsabstand?

**Ein letzter Tauchgang**

Tierpfleger Bene darf an seinem letzten Arbeitstag noch einmal ins Becken steigen und die Scheiben für seine geliebten Brillenpinguine reinigen. Bene genießt den Moment: noch einmal mit seinen Schützlingen im Wasser.

Außerdem verabschiedet er sich auf einer Tour durch den Zoo von den Tieren. Währenddessen laufen heimliche Vorbereitungen für seinen Abschied.

**Übung mit der Jetbox**

Bei den Jägerliesten läuft das Training für die erste große Präsentation auf Hochtouren. Tierpflegerin Angela versucht, die vier Vögel an die Transportkiste zu gewöhnen, eine wichtige Voraussetzung für ihren späteren Auftritt im ARTrium.

Obwohl das Training Konzentration verlangt, bringen die „lachenden Hänse“ mit ihrem unverwechselbaren Gelächter viel Leben in die Voliere. Vorher müssen alle noch gewogen werden. Es geht kreuz und quer, die Vögel fliegen auf die Waage, wie sie lustig sind. Kann Angela noch den Überblick behalten?

**Neuer Glanz für die Teebar**

Im Reich der Gorillas wird der Termitenhügel gründlich repariert. Marvin und Ray arbeiten daran, gefährliche Kanten zu schließen und die Röhren so abzusichern, dass die neugierigen Menschenaffen sich nicht verletzen können.

Währenddessen bereiten Sarah und Patrick auf der Außenanlage ein großzügiges Frühstück mit dem beliebten Früchtetee vor, inklusive frischer Äste, die als „Trinkhalme“ dienen. Als die Gruppe schließlich herausgelassen wird, stürzen sich vor allem die Jungen Tara und Anandi auf den neu gemachten Hügel. Doch die erwachsenen Tiere scheinen zunächst nur Augen für ihre Mahlzeit zu haben …

**Unterricht für den großen Auftritt**

Im ARTrium bekommt Rabengeier Nestor eine behutsame Trainingseinheit, damit er bald sicher vor Publikum auftreten kann. Tierpflegerin Angela arbeitet Schritt für Schritt mit ihm, der Vogel soll sich immer besser mit der fremden Umgebung vertraut machen.

An diesem Tag zeigt sich der Rabengeier erstaunlich entspannt und meistert erste Aufgaben, obwohl der pieksige Boden unter seinen Füßen manchmal kitzelt ...

programme.desc:
Die besten Geschichten schreibt das Leben.

Luxus und Laster, Klatsch und Tratsch, Lust und Liebe, Show und Unterhaltung, Rat- und Tat-Themen.

Menschen, Mode, Lifestyle, Gesellschaft, Trends, Verbraucherinformationen, aber auch Unglücke, Urteile, Kriminalität, Skurriles, Menschliches und allzu Menschliches – all das steckt in „Brisant“. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc:
Zwei Teamkapitäne stellen sich gemeinsam mit den Kandidaten der Quizshow den unglaublichen und überraschenden Fragen des Moderators Kai Pflaume.

Seit der ersten Sendung im Juli 2015 waren das die Quizmaster Elton und Bernhard Hoëcker. Im Oktober 2025 übergab Elton den Staffelstab an den Schauspieler Wotan Wilke Möhring, der seitdem im Team mit einem prominenten Studiogast gegen Bernhard Hoëckers Team antritt.

Es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. Beide Teams spielen um Bares für ihre Unterstützer.

Zu Beginn des Wissensspiels müssen sich die Zuschauer im Studio entscheiden: Setzen sie sich auf die Seite von Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker oder von „Kommissar“ Wotan Wilke Möhring?

Moderator Kai Pflaume sorgt für eine ausgeglichene Balance zwischen den Teamkapitänen, die zuweilen hoch emotional werden können. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Dr. Ben Ahlbeck und Assistenzärztin Sofia Galura versorgen den schwer verletzten Feuerwehrmann Sören Dahmen (Niklas Hummel) nach einem heftigen Autounfall. Doch als Ben die Ehefrau verständigen will, reagiert Sören panisch und abweisend. \n\nKurz darauf taucht Nathalie Dahmen in der Notaufnahme auf – und fällt aus allen Wolken, weil ihr Mann zu diesem Zeitpunkt eigentlich auf der Wache sein sollte...

programme.title: Wunschkind – Der Usedom-Krimi
programme.desc: Nathalie, die leibliche Mutter, hat ihr Leben endlich in den Griff bekommen und will das Sorgerecht zurück. Pflegemutter Anja ist seit Jahren für Greta da, sieht sie als ihre eigene Tochter. Juristin Karin unterstützt Nathalie, während ihr Neffe Rainer gemeinsam mit Kollegin Ellen bald schon in einem Mordfall ermittelt: Der Pflegevater wurde getötet. Die Situation spitzt sich immer mehr zu – und Karin gerät in ein moralisches Dilemma… \n\nDem Film sowie seinen Darstellerinnen gelingt es, ein komplexes Beziehungsgeflecht feinfühlig zu zeigen und beiden Seiten eine stimmige, berührende Perspektive zu geben. Ein leiser Krimi, fast mehr Drama, der aber gerade wegen dieses emotionalen Zwiespalts hoch spannend ist.

programme.title: Monitor
programme.desc:
**Trumps Oligarchie: Amerika als Beute?**

Während das tägliche Leben der Bürger immer teurer wird, nutzt Präsident Trump seine Macht, um sich selbst zu bereichern. Kritiker sprechen von einer Kleptokratie, in der politische Macht, familiäre Interessen und milliardenschwere Geschäfte Hand in Hand gehen.

Was bedeutet das Ergebnis der Midterms für die Milliardengeschäfte des Trump-Clans – und für ihre Zukunft?

**Geheimdienst-Pensionäre: Ex-Agenten außer Kontrolle**

Der Fall des inhaftierten Ex-BND-Chefs August Hanning hat das Zeug zu einer Spionage-Affäre. Doch er legte auch offen, was viele nicht sehen wollten: Top-Agenten können ihr Wissen im Ruhestand an private Akteure oder fremde Mächte verkaufen – ganz legal.

Gemeinsame Recherchen von MONITOR mit WDR, NDR und Süddeutscher Zeitung zeigen, dass Hanning dabei längst kein Einzelfall ist. Trotz jahrelanger Warnungen fehlen bis heute wirksame Kontrollmechanismen.

**Generation Wut: verlorene Jugend?**

Nach den Jugendprotesten in Deutschland zeigen Politiker Verständnis für jene Jugendlichen, die in zahlreichen Städten friedlich protestiert haben. Doch was folgt daraus, wenn der Alltag von Schülern und Studierenden durch Investitionsstau, Wohnungsnot, soziale Ungerechtigkeit und Unsicherheit geprägt ist?

Ihre Zustimmung zu den Parteien der sogenannten „Mitte“ nimmt dramatisch ab. Hat die Politik die Jugend schon verloren? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tagesthemen
programme.desc:
Diese Sendungen bieten als vertiefendes Nachrichtenformat der ARD täglich eine umfassende Einordnung der wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die zentralen Entwicklungen des Tages, ergänzt durch Analysen, Hintergrundberichte und Interviews.

Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten ordnen das Geschehen aus dem In- und Ausland ein und liefern zusätzliche Perspektiven zu den wichtigsten Schlagzeilen.

Es wird bewusst auf vertiefende Berichterstattung und Kontextualisierung gesetzt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nuhr im Ersten
programme.desc: Dieter Nuhr seziert messerscharf politische Unzulänglichkeiten, thematische Abseitigkeiten und den verlässlichen Irrwitz des Alltags und lädt zu jeder Sendung diverse Gäste ein. \n\nSeit Januar 2011 moderiert Dieter Nuhr die Sendung. Zuvor führte der Kabarettist Mathias Richling mit gekonnten Parodien und verspielter Komik durch die Sendung. Aus dem „Scheibenwischer“ wurde zuerst der „Satiregipfel“ und jetzt heißt es wieder „Nuhr im Ersten“.

programme.title: Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc: Kein Zucker, kein Fernsehen, jeden Tag frisch kochen, niemals lügen und natürlich nur pädagogisch wertvolles Holzspielzeug: "Die Carolin Kebekus Show" zerstört all die Elternmythen über gute Erziehung! Carolin kennt das: Da kauft man sich jede Menge Kochbücher mit gesunden Gerichten – aber der Nachwuchs nimmt das Gemüse dann doch am liebsten in Form von Ketchup zu sich. Über diese und weitere gescheiterte Erziehungsvorsätze kann sich Carolin bestens mit ihrem Gast, Hazel Brugger, austauschen: Bei Hazels letztem Besuch haben die beiden noch eine Babyparty mit einem Publikum voller Schwangeren gefeiert. Jetzt gibt es einen Rückblick und einen Reality-Check: Was hat sich seit den Geburten verändert und von welchen Erziehungsvorsätzen haben sich die beiden inzwischen verabschiedet? Anschließend treten Hazel und Carolin in einem Battle gegeneinander an. Bei "Nur die Lüge zählt" darf ganz offiziell getäuscht und geschummelt werden: Ist der Koffer leer oder schwer? Ist das Essen süß oder salzig? Und läuft auf dem Kopfhörer Pumuckl oder ein Porno? Wer von den beiden kann die als Mutter gelernten "Lügen-Skills" besser anwenden? Die Antwort gibt es in der "Carolin Kebekus Show"! Die neue Staffel der "Carolin Kebekus Show" ist immer donnerstags um 19.30 Uhr in der ARD Mediathek und um 23:35 Uhr im Ersten zu sehen. Im WDR wird die Folge am Montag, 9. November, um 23.00 Uhr wiederholt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc: Die beiden Rätselmeister Bernhard Hoëcker und Elton stellen sich erneut den unglaublichen, amüsanten und überraschenden Fragen von Moderator Kai Pflaume. Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker und Quizmaster Elton spielen im Team mit jeweils einem prominenten Studiogast, denn es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. (Erstausstrahlung im Ersten: 16.04.2025).

programme.title: ZDF-Mittagsmagazin

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Ce n'est pas parce qu'on atteint un âge mûre que la vie devient nécessairement monotone. programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Fürstenhof, hôtel cinq étoile au cœur de Vagen en Bavière, est l'épicentre des histoires qui lient de nombreux habitants de la région. Qu'il s'agisse de ses propriétaires, son petit personnel ou d'autres personnalités influentes, les intrigues mêlant amour, argent, famille et trahison qui gravitent autour de l'établissement sont nombreuses.

programme.title: Seelöwe & Co. - tierisch beliebt

programme.title: Brisant

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?

programme.title: Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión
programme.sub-title: Su pasado y el futuro de ellos
programme.desc: Después de años buscando una vivienda, Ted y Erin heredaron una casa en Los Ángeles que debería solucionar su problema, aunque se trataba de la casa en la que Ted había criado a sus hijos con su exmujer. Para Ted Es una casa llena de recuerdos, pero Erin no tiene claro que pueda considerarlo su propio espacio. En el dilema entre mantener el pasado y construir juntos el futuro, Ted y Erin recurren a Jonathan y Drew para que les ayuden a tomar una decisión crucial: ¿renovar la casa llena de recuerdos de Ted o buscar un nuevo hogar donde ambos puedan empezar una vida propia?

programme.title: Reforma sin obra
programme.sub-title: Un oasis en la mini terraza
programme.desc: En esta ocasión, Carol se enfrenta a un doble reto: convertir la terraza interior de Leti en un vergel, un oasis en el que la vegetación esté muy presente, y sacar partido al pequeño espacio disponible. Lo más difícil será aprovechar los escasos metros que tiene, pero cuenta con la ventaja de unos ventanales que le aportan mucha luz.

programme.title: La casa más top
programme.desc: Tres vecinos de la misma calle tienen tres interpretaciones muy diferentes de la vida en el West End de este barrio histórico. Ahora se enfrentan para ver quién tiene el mejor estilo; luchando por ver quién luce realmente elegante al estilo West End y quién será ignorado con cortesía en la próxima fiesta vecinal.

programme.title: Tus plantas decoran
programme.desc: Hace siglos, Aristóteles escribió: 'En todas las cosas de la naturaleza hay algo de maravilloso'. Una afirmación que cobra vida en este episodio, en el que aprenderemos a mirar con otros ojos plantas como la petunia o la iresine y visitaremos el Taller de Florinatta, un lugar donde Eva transforma las flores en recuerdos, convirtiendo lo efímero en perdurable.

programme.title: Redecora con Raquel
programme.desc: Raquel y Jota son una pareja joven que se acaban de comprar un piso. Desde hace un año, llevan reutilizando muebles de distintas casas y aunque han reformado la cocina, el espacio carece de uniformidad y las diferentes estancias no están integradas entre sí. Raquel elaborará un proyecto que incluye cocina, comedor, salón y recibidor. A ver si consigue poner de acuerdo con ambos en la elección de la nueva decoración.

programme.title: Castillos y palacios de Europa
programme.desc: En el corazón de Rumanía, descubrimos el fastuoso Castillo de Peleș, símbolo del poder real, y su contraparte aristocrática, el Castillo Cantacuzino. Una historia de ego y opulencia donde mármoles y jardines infinitos fueron las armas de una competencia sin igual por deslumbrar a la alta sociedad.

programme.title: Minipisos asombrosos
programme.desc: La mayoría de las viviendas españolas se construyeron en los años 70, muchas otras, a principios de siglo. En el programa de hoy comprobamos cómo aquellos minipisos angostos llenos de tabiques y habitaciones se pueden convertir en espacios con mucha luz, tecnología y modernidad.

programme.title: Limpia y ordena
programme.desc: Mark Wright, Melissa Lee y Amie Williams ayudan a Katherine y Danny a adaptar su pequeña casa tras acoger a su nieta Lacey, de dos años. Entre juguetes, discos y otros objetos personales, la vivienda se ha quedado pequeño para la nueva vida familiar. El equipo crea almacenaje a medida bajo la escalera, organiza la colección musical de Danny y diseña una pantalla para que el loro Herbie tenga su propio rincón. El resultado es un hogar más sereno, amplio y adaptado para todos.

programme.title: Hoteles increíbles. La vida más allá del vestíbulo
programme.desc: En este episodio Rob Rinder y Monica Galetti visitan el Intercontinental Shanghai Wonderland, reconocido internacionalmente como el primer hotel 'rascasuelo' del mundo. Allí descubrirán los retos arquitectónicos que supone construir un hotel incrustado en la ladera de una cantera. Además, el equipo colaborará en tareas tan curiosas como preparar la cena para los 3.000 peces del acuario, probar drones para el deslumbrante espectáculo nocturno de luces, atender a los comensales en una cena privada e incluso ayudar en los preparativos de una fiesta de cumpleaños para una niña.

programme.title: La casa de mis sueños
programme.desc: Kat y Ryan estaban recién casados cuando se quedaron a vivir en el piso de soltero de él; pero ahora, con dos hijos de por medio, están deseando tener una casa familiar espaciosa. Drew los lleva a una vivienda señorial con una buena estructura, pero una oferta baja les impide negociar. Sin embargo, la búsqueda de casa da un giro sorprendente. Más adelante, Jonathan se enfrenta a una serie de costosos problemas que afectan al presupuesto y obligan a todos a buscar soluciones creativas.

programme.title: Busco piso
programme.desc: Felipe ha cruzado el océano con una idea clara: empezar una nueva etapa en España, estudiar y construir su propio camino. Recién llegado desde Latinoamérica, todavía no ha podido encontrar su lugar y vive temporalmente en casa de una amiga de su madre. Ahora siente que ha llegado el momento de dar el salto y buscar su propio piso, un espacio donde ganar independencia y vivir a su manera. En esta búsqueda contará con la ayuda de Alicia Mesa, la arquitecta que le acompañará para encontrar un hogar que encaje con su presupuesto y su estilo de vida. Entre pisos ya reformados y otros con potencial para empezar desde cero, Felipe tendrá que decidir qué tipo de hogar quiere para comenzar su nueva vida. ¿Apostará por la comodidad de un piso ya reformado o se atreverá a crear su hogar desde la base? En este episodio de Busco piso, veremos cómo se enfrenta a una decisión que puede marcar su futuro.

programme.title: Reforma Integral
programme.desc: Antonio ha cambiado de vida y se ha ido a una gran ciudad en busca de un nuevo futuro laboral. El problema es que el apartamento que piensa ocupar con su pareja no cubre necesidades básicas de espacio y precisa de una zona de trabajo. El reto de la arquitecta Beatriz Moral será rediseñar la casa de sus sueños en un tiempo récord. ¡No te puedes perder el resultado de esta reforma integral!

programme.title: Minicasas sorprendentes
programme.desc: Miquel y Marc construyeron la minicabaña de sus sueños suspendida en tres robles de la Sierra de Milany en Girona. Una minivivienda de cuento hecha completamente a mano. Joaquín Pretel ha reformado una minicueva de más de cientocincuenta años de antigüedad, transformando esta tradicional vivienda de la localidad granadina de Monachil en una minicasa natural de gran eficiencia energética.

programme.title: La cocina de tus sueños 2.0
programme.desc: En el programa de hoy, Alejandro se enfrenta a un caso único en su carrera: la reforma de una cocina condicionada a un papel elegido para una de sus paredes. La propietaria se enamoró de un estampado que, a toda costa, quiere que esté presente; además está deseando cambiar por completo su cocina. El problema surge porque hay poco espacio y no hay forma de ampliarlo tirando algún tabique. Aun así, la dueña cuenta con tener todos los electrodomésticos en ella, quiere mucho almacenaje e incluso una mesa y un desayunador. Nuestro profesional se ha sentido muy descolocado con este proyecto y le ha supuesto muchos quebraderos de cabeza, pero no se pierdan el programa de hoy porque Alejandro siempre encuentra soluciones para todo.

programme.title: Limpia y ordena
programme.desc: Mark Wright, Melissa Lee y Amie Williams ayudan a Katherine y Danny a adaptar su pequeña casa tras acoger a su nieta Lacey, de dos años. programme.title: De sin a con
programme.sub-title: Una habitación en suite / Dormitorios de ciudad
programme.desc: El nuevo reto de Virginia Albuja consistirá en convertir una pequeña habitación con baño y vestidor en una espectacular suite. Acompañándola en este episodio, veremos cómo Héctor Ruiz, gracias a una arquitectura única, dará un cambio radical a unos dormitorios encapsulados.

programme.title: Los gemelos reforman de nuevo
programme.desc: Vivimos una época en la que la vivienda es un valor muy caro y mudarse cuesta mucho. Por ello, la serie 'Los gemelos reforman de nuevo' es un referente como modelo para sacarle el mejor partido a la casa en la que residimos transformando su interior en espacios polivalentes de ensueño. La serie muestra algunos de los mayores retos que hasta la fecha los hermanos Scott, Jonathan y Drew, han tenido que acometer. En esta ocasión los gemelos se encuentran con familias que no pueden o no quieren mudarse. Cada episodio nos traerá sorpresas y pondrá a prueba la templanza de los gemelos por un viaje emocional de los propietarios de estas viviendas para conseguir un hogar del que sentirse orgullosos.

programme.title: Reforma y Alquila
programme.desc: Patricia González viaja al pasado a través de una auténtica cápsula del tiempo: una vivienda que conserva intactos los elementos originales de su antiguo propietario, desde los muebles hasta los más pequeños detalles. El reto no será solo transformar este hogar, sino traerlo al presente con tan solo… 26 000 euros.

programme.title: DW News
programme.desc: DW News is news and information channel from a German international broadcaster Deutsche Well (German Wall). It provides latest news from Europe and all around the world in several languages on a daily basis. The service is transmitted worldwide via satellite with a reach of more than 197 million people on a weekly basis. Their motto is Made for minds. DW news is informative, entertaining, up-to-date and what is even more important, reliable source of news, the content is intended to be independent of government influence.
